problem: Generic MKB outreach asks prospects to understand an abstract digitalisation/AI proposition before trust, urgency and fit are established, while current B2B buying behaviour increasingly favours self-directed research and relevant contextual contact.
root_cause: The Revenue & Growth Core ranked latent demand but did not explicitly encode company-specific buying triggers, problem hypotheses, entry offers or partner-distribution routes as evidence-backed opportunity context.
prevention: TRIGGER_BEFORE_OUTREACH: prefer company-specific evidence of a buying moment over generic cold outreach.
NO_TRIGGER_FABRICATION: when evidence does not support a company-specific trigger, persist INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and do not invent urgency.
PROBLEM_BEFORE_TECH: translate verified signals into a concrete management problem hypothesis before proposing AI, data or digitalisation.
ENTRY_OFFER_REDUCES_RISK: use Frisse Blik as the diagnostic bridge into paid scan, implementation and portal/SaaS when the trigger fits.

PARTNER_DISTRIBUTION_IS_FIRST_CLASS: accountants, M&A advisers, investors/PE, banks, municipalities, trade associations, ERP/AFAS partners, MSP/IT partners and business advisers are explicit distribution routes.
CONTENT_IS_PRESALES: content should answer concrete CEO/directie/MT problems with data, diagnosis, actions and proof instead of generic transformation messaging.
OUTREACH_IS_CONTEXT_LED: every suggested outreach action must explain why now, what problem is hypothesised, what evidence supports it and the smallest relevant next step.
OUTCOMES_CLOSE_THE_LOOP: replies, meetings, scans, proposals, orders and realised revenue must calibrate trigger effectiveness and partner/channel performance.
